sections.title: Prerequisites & Intuition (0:00-0:45)
lecture_lines: Where they land defines the new space.
animations: Show a 3D grid with the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] at the origin. Highlight basis vectors i (1,0,0), j (0,1,0), k (0,0,1) in #FF0000, #00FF00, #0000FF.
Stretch the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] along the x-axis, observing i change position.
Stretch the cube along the y-axis, observing j change position.
Stretch the cube along the z-axis, observing k change position.
Overlay the final basis vector positions to illustrate space deformation of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg].

sections.title: The Transformation Matrix (0:45-2:00)
lecture_lines: Columns show destinations of basis vectors.
Grid lines remain parallel and uniform.
animations: Display a 3x3 matrix outline with placeholders for basis vectors using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Animate basis vector i moving to the first column position.
Animate basis vector j moving to the second column position.
Animate basis vector k moving to the third column position.
Demonstrate the transformation of a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg], showing lines stay parallel.

sections.title: Visualizing Rotations and Scaling (2:00-3:30)
animations: Show a 3D wireframe [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] at the origin.
Apply a scaling transformation to show the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] stretching.
Highlight diagonal elements of the scaling matrix in #FFFF00.
Rotate the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] 45 degrees around the z-axis.
Simultaneously display rotation and scaling effect on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg].

sections.title: Determinants and Composition (3:30-4:30)
animations: Represent the object as a unit cube [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] with volume 1.0.
Apply a transformation to the cube [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg], show the new volume scaling to det(M).
Display two transformation matrices A and B next to each other.
Perform matrix multiplication A * B to show the composition.
Show that multiplying B * A yields a different result for the unit cube [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg].

sections.title: Summary & Real-world Application (4:30-5:00)
animations: Display a summarized 3D character (robotic bird) based on [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bird.svg].
Animate the 'squash and stretch' effect using a transformation matrix.
Conclude by showing the 3D model projecting the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bird.svg] onto a 2D screen.
